title: Cerberus Config
description: Configuration file for Cerberus, the Tiamat ecosystem service manager.

services.description: List of services managed by Cerberus.

project.description: Parent project this service belongs to.

dir.description: Working directory for the service. Supports ~ for home directory.

command.description: Command and arguments to start the service.

build.description: Optional build command to run before starting.

env_file.description: Path to an env file to load (relative to dir).

url.description: URL where the service is accessible.

tags.description: Tags for filtering and grouping services.

health.description: Legacy health check URL. Prefer health_check instead.

depends_on.description: IDs of services this service depends on.

auto_start.description: Start this service automatically when Cerberus launches.

auto_restart.description: Automatically restart the service if it exits.

profiles.description: Profiles this service belongs to for selective startup.

HealthCheck.description: Health check configuration for a service.

url.description: URL to poll for health status (expects 2xx).

command.description: Command to run for health check (exit 0 = healthy).

interval.description: How often to run the health check (Go duration).

timeout.description: Timeout for each health check attempt (Go duration).
